description: Defines the MidiManagerUsb class for managing USB-MIDI devices, including device enumeration, data transmission, and input/output stream handling within the midi namespace.

classes.name: MidiManagerUsb
classes.description: Manages USB-MIDI devices, handles device attachment/detachment, data transmission, and input stream events.

methods.name: MidiManagerUsb
methods.description: Constructor initializing the manager with a MidiService and device factory.

methods.name: StartInitialization
methods.description: Begins the initialization process for the MIDI manager.

methods.name: DispatchSendMidiData
methods.description: Sends MIDI data to a specified client and port with a timestamp.

methods.name: ReceiveUsbMidiData
methods.description: Handles incoming MIDI data from a USB device.

methods.name: OnDeviceAttached
methods.description: Handles a new device being attached.

methods.name: OnReceivedData
methods.description: Handles data received from an input stream.

methods.name: AddPorts
methods.description: Adds ports from a device to the manager.
